projectsData.title: Mobile Jewelry App
projectsData.description: This project was done in collaboration with ColorTheoryVintage, a small business out of Columbus Ohio, to make a jewelry resale platform for small businesses. The developers used ReactNative and Firebase. Capabilities include texting system, uploading products, and more.

projectsData.title: BobcatCoin Foundations
projectsData.description: This project evaluated methods and capabilities for implementing a digital cryptocurrency system into the club economy. This system can be used for things like club voting, awards, and more.

projectsData.title: Plex Server
projectsData.description: Launched club Plex server on old Macbook for the weekly club movies. This system contains movies, music, literature, and more. Club members were granted authenticated access to the server.

projectsData.title: Club Website Model
projectsData.description: This project revamped the club website. The site had new functionality which utilized the GitHub API to dynamically showcase progress on each of the clubs members and repos. This was done using Angular.

projectsData.title: Launching Garduino
projectsData.description: Purchased necessary materials and began work on construction of an automated gardening system using an Arduino board.

springProjects.title: Open Web AY
springProjects.description: This tool is designed to be an open source alternative to web accessibility. The tool is a free option largely aimed at underrepresented portions of the internet (solo developers, small businesses, etc), who want a lightweight, free, and customizable option. This project was started as a solo submission to BlossomHack 2024 and won "Best Overall". It currently has around 2,000 downloads.

springProjects.title: Local Market, Athens
springProjects.description: Project launched to combine online shopping with small businesses. The project creates an online shop for all local Athens goods that users can shop at similar to an Amazon. The site aims to compete with Amazon and Walmart while giving the power to small businesses.

springProjects.title: Roblox Game Jam
springProjects.description: Game jam focused on introduction to game design fundamentals and Lua scripting through Roblox Studio. Three games were created and posted on Roblox servers.

currentProjectsData.title: TIC-80
currentProjectsData.description: TIC-80 is a tiny computer where you write programs in Lua and use the built in game editor to make fun 8-bit games.

currentProjectsData.title: Fitness WatchOS
currentProjectsData.description: In this project you will gamify fitness by writing a WatchOS application in Swift.

currentProjectsData.title: Grade Calculator
currentProjectsData.description: This project includes the development of a tool used for calculating needed and expected grades. Potential users include professors and students.

currentProjectsData.title: Garduino
currentProjectsData.description: With preliminary work completed for the Garduino, the project is now looking for students who are interested in joining the group. You will be using an Arduino to automate gardening systems.

pastProjectsData.title: OUCare
pastProjectsData.description: OUCare was a project submitted for a Hackathon that centered around healthcare accessibility on college campuses. The project went through several iterations, using React and Vew for front-end. It also used a Twilio text bot client, OpenStreetMaps API, Google Maps API, and more.

pastProjectsData.title: Social Media TUI
pastProjectsData.description: This project created an interface for a social media run through the terminal. This was created using Rust.

pastProjectsData.title: GSuite TUI
pastProjectsData.description: This project used Rust and Python to create a terminal user interface for the Google suite. This allowed users to utilize the google suite from their terminal. This included reading and writing emails, checking calendars, and more.
